name: Hey_10
short_caption: The robot raises its right hand to perform a friendly, one-handed wave.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and raises its right arm forward and upward with an open hand facing the viewer. It holds the hand steady in a waving position for about two seconds, maintaining direct eye contact with the viewer. Finally, it smoothly lowers the arm back down to its side, returning to the neutral starting posture.
safety_notes: The right arm extends forward and slightly to the right side; ensure a clear envelope of approximately 50cm around the robot's right upper body.
